source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة، طلب مني جدي أروح عالضيعة أجيبله دوا.
sentences.en: Once, my grandfather asked me to go to the village to get him medicine.

sentences.ar: ركبت الباص الصبح والطريق كان طويل.
sentences.en: I took the bus in the morning and the road was long.
I got off in the village and asked about the pharmacy.

sentences.ar: رجال طيب دلني عليها ومشى معي شوي.
sentences.en: A kind man showed me to it and walked with me a bit.
I bought the medicine and thanked the pharmacist.

sentences.ar: قبل ما أرجع، مريت عالسوق وشريت خضرة.
sentences.en: Before going back, I passed by the market and bought vegetables.
The people in the village were simple and kind.

sentences.ar: رجعت عالبيت بالمسا ومعي الدوا والخضرة.
sentences.en: I went home in the evening with the medicine and the vegetables.
My grandfather was very happy with me and blessed me.
